name: chunk_local_cumsum_scalar
description: Per-chunk scalar-gate cumulative sum with signature chunk_local_cumsum_scalar(g, chunk_size, reverse=False, scale=None). g has shape [B,T,H] and T is partitioned into contiguous chunks of chunk_size. For each (b, chunk, head), compute the cumulative sum along time within the chunk; reverse=True computes the cumulative sum from the chunk end back to its start, and scale multiplies the result when provided. Return a newly allocated float32 tensor with the same [B,T,H] shape; inputs are not modified. The implementation launches over full chunks, so T is expected to be divisible by chunk_size. The suite exercises bfloat16 g with chunk sizes 8/16/32 and with reverse and scale variants.
